description: Use when the user wants to find live events on XP — concerts, sports, theater — by performer, team, venue, city, or keyword (e.g. 'tickets to the season opener', 'shows near me this weekend'). Surfaces the connected order book of resale + primary inventory in one feed. Do not use for scores, news, standings, or non-ticketed listings; use a web tool for those.

cbsa.description: Metro area filter (synonyms: city, near me, area). ISO US CBSA code or name.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

max_date.description: Filter events on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). For relative phrases like 'this weekend' or 'next month', resolve against _meta.context.today.

min_date.description: Filter events on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). For relative phrases like 'this weekend' or 'next month', resolve against _meta.context.today.

name: search_events
title: Search Events
